Termux runs llama.cpp directly on the phone, so Parley keeps working without Wi-Fi or a computer.

1. Install Termux from F-Droid. The Play Store build is outdated.

2. Open Termux and run:
pkg update && pkg upgrade
pkg install llama-cpp

3. Copy a GGUF model to the phone, for example qwen2.5-3b-instruct-q4_K_M.gguf, then run:
llama-server -m /sdcard/Download/qwen2.5-3b-instruct-q4_K_M.gguf --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080

4. Keep this screen on http://127.0.0.1:8080 and model name local.

Keep Termux running while you practice. The smaller 1.5B model is faster on phones; the 3B model gives better answers. Everything stays on the device.
